name: Qu Wong
source:
Not much is known about him except he is the leader of the terrorist group Fei Dao and leads the people of the underground city Level 7. 

[From [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=3445&showallach=1#characterlist]AniDB[/url]]

[spoiler]While Qu Wong branded as a religious extremist by the government, in reality he is a terrorist in name only, being a core player in the fight against the conspiracy to produce brainwashing chips. In the past, he worked with Tachibana, though the two became bitter enemies over ideological differences. He ran away with the neuro-chip test subjects and founded Level-7 as a refugee center.[/spoiler]
